versions.changelog:
Initial release of cn-meme-generator.

- Generate Chinese meme images with text overlay or AI-generated content.
- Supports two modes: text mode (overlay top/bottom text) and AI mode (generate with Pollinations AI).
- Command-line usage with customizable options for mode, text, AI prompt, and output path.
- PNG output with transparent background and automatic text wrapping/scaling.
- No internet needed for text mode; AI mode uses free, no-key Pollinations API.
- Requires Python 3.x, Pillow, and requests.
